reference_sql:
WITH starts AS (
  -- one row per session_start event of 1 to 7 December 2025 (Dublin days): only the column the count needs
  SELECT device.category AS device_category
  FROM events
  WHERE event_name = 'session_start'
    AND event_date BETWEEN '20251201' AND '20251207'
)
SELECT device_category, COUNT(*) AS sessions
FROM starts
GROUP BY device_category

  SELECT device.category AS device_category
  FROM events
  WHERE event_name = 'session_start'
    AND CAST(strptime(event_date, '%Y%m%d') AS DATE) BETWEEN DATE '2025-12-01' AND DATE '2025-12-07'
)
SELECT device_category, COUNT(*) AS sessions
